Theorem
[the Convergence Theorem of Riemannian Geometry]

Source: petersen:page-0445 ↗ thm:pet-ch11-anderson-injectivity-radius-controls-norm 1. ch11:11.4.7For $R,K>0$, there are $Q,r>0$ such that every $(M,g)$ with $\inj \ge R$ and $|\sec |\le K$ satisfies $\| (M,g)\| ^{\mathrm{har}}_{C^{1,\alpha },r}\le Q$; in particular this class is compact in the pointed $C^{1,\alpha }$ topology for all $\alpha <1$.
